product: Trade Marketplace web app — customers post any job free, accept one fixed price, someone local sorts it. Tradies/workers claim priced jobs, estimate from photos, or quote in person.
sources_of_truth: Trade Marketplace Front-End Build Guide.pdf (tokens, components, 390px mobile screens)
Trade Marketplace Web App Design Spec.pdf (this kit: desktop pages, inventory, effects, motion)

categories.other_means: Any kind of labour not in the main list (moving, cleaning, gardening, handyman, assembly, rubbish removal, anything). “Not sure” also goes to Other. Anyone can take Other jobs.

job_kinds_for_tradies.ready_to_claim: Priced + paid; shows what the tradie earns; first in gets it
job_kinds_for_tradies.needs_estimate: Blind estimate from photos (hours + materials), private
job_kinds_for_tradies.quote_bounty: Gold $30 bounty, 24h: go and quote in person, send a fixed price; AI checks it; first dibs if accepted + fair (new status QUOTE_BOUNTY)

pages.name: Home / landing
pages.what: Hero + “What needs doing?” search, how it works (3 steps), categories, popular jobs, why us (fixed price, checked tradies, no surprise bills), reviews, For tradies band, FAQ teaser, final CTA, footer
pages.states: Signed-out · signed-in redirects to app home · region not covered
notes: Transparent site nav at the top of the hero. As scrolling starts it turns solid Forest with a shadow (M06), keeping the logo and links clear of moving hero content (#375). “For tradies” in Amber.

Hero: 92px Display headline (M07 reveal), one search bar = the main action. Typing + Enter or “Get a price” opens Post a job with the text filled in. Location defaults from the browser (ask once) or IP; editable.
Example chips pre-fill the search. Trust row: three facts, no numbers we can’t back up yet.
Floating “price ready” card shows the product in one glance. Slight 2° tilt, floats 6px up/down slowly (3s loop, off with reduced motion).
How it works: 3 cards, lift on hover (M03). Copy never mentions estimates.
Categories: the main trades + “Other”, which means any kind of labour (moving, cleaning, gardening, handyman, assembly, rubbish…). Every tile starts Post a job with that type picked.
Why us: 3 promises + photo collage (photos zoom on hover, M03).
Reviews: real reviews only, pulled from the database once we have them. Until then, hide this section.
For tradies band in trade colours (Amber bolt) → /for-tradies.
FAQ accordion (M24) + repeat of the search box before the footer. Footer: 4 link columns, NZBN, socials.

pages.name: How it works
pages.what: The 3 steps in detail for customers (no pricing machinery), what’s included, guarantees, FAQ, CTA
notes: Short Forest header (no search). Same site nav (active page underlined).
Each step: giant outlined number, short copy, a mini piece of real UI on the right. Rows rise in as they scroll into view (M01, once).
Customer-facing: no estimates, margins or pricing maths. Link to Help for the curious.
Ends with the same CTA band as the landing (not shown).

pages.name: For tradies
pages.what: Pitch to workers: jobs already priced, no lead fees, we do the paperwork. How it works for tradies, what you earn, requirements per trade, sign-up CTA, tradie FAQ
notes: Whole page in trade mode: Hi-Vis/Amber accents, Amber bolt. Hero CTA “Join as a tradie” → /signup/tradie.
Right side: floating job cards showing “Earn” + an “It’s yours” toast. Cards float gently (3s loop); headline reveals with M07.
Four reasons in plain tradie talk. Icons in trade tint.
Requirements box: the honest list. Licensed trades need their licence; “Other” work (any labour) needs ID only. Pull from the trade config.
Below (not shown): earnings example, FAQ for tradies, testimonials from tradies once real, final CTA, footer.

pages.name: Service pages (per trade)
pages.what: SEO landing per trade incl. /services/other (“Anything else”): hero, common jobs, how it works, reviews, CTA
notes: One template for every trade, including /services/other (“Anything else”: moving, cleaning, gardening, assembly…), and later trade × city (A05). Content from the trade config + CMS.
Crumbs + H1 with trade and city for SEO. Same hero search, type pre-set to the trade.
Popular jobs grid: each tile starts Post a job with that job pre-filled.
If the trade isn’t live yet: hero says “Coming soon” and the search becomes a waitlist form (A07).

pages.name: Location pages (per city)
pages.what: SEO: “Electricians in Invercargill”, local stats, suburbs covered, CTA. Same template as A04

pages.name: Trust & safety
pages.what: How tradies are checked, licences, CoC, insurance, payments held securely, what happens if something goes wrong, contact
notes: Plain-language trust page. Every claim must be true on launch day (check with Matt).
Bolt-flash illustration (M10 plays once on load).
Six promises as cards. Link each to its help article.

pages.name: Not in your area yet
pages.what: Shown when an address is outside coverage: friendly message, waitlist email + suburb, share link
notes: Shown when an entered address is outside coverage (on landing, post a job step 3, or a service page). Never let them post a job we can’t do.
Suburb comes from the address they typed. Email + suburb saved to a waitlist table.
Success replaces nothing: a success banner appears under the form (M01) with a share link.
List of live areas from coverage settings (F14).

pages.what: Split layout: brand panel left, form right (email, password, show/hide, forgot, log in, sign up link)
notes: Split layout ≥1024: Forest brand panel (bolt, illustration, line) left; form centred in the right half, max 440px. Under 1024: the mobile log-in screen.
Underline fields (original style). Error shown under the fields after submit, keeps the email, clears the password. After 5 tries: “Too many tries. Wait 10 minutes or reset your password.”
“Keep me logged in” = 30-day session, else browser session.
Log in button shown in its hover state (brightness 1.06, M04). Enter submits.
After log-in: back to the page they came from (?next=), else their home. Mode set from role.

pages.name: Sign up · choose

notes: Desktop puts the role choice and the details on one screen. Choosing “I’m a tradie” swaps the right side to the tradie form and the page to trade colours (cross-fade 200ms).
Choice cards: hover = light fill (shown on the tradie card). Selected = action border + tint.
Password strength bar (4 segments) + plain hint. No rules list unless they fail one.
Email already used → inline error with “Log in instead?” link.
On success → Verify email (B05). If they came from “Post it”, the job posts right after verifying.

notes: Desktop puts the role choice and the details on one screen. Choosing “I’m a tradie” swaps the right side to the tradie form and the page to trade colours (cross-fade 200ms).

notes: Trade mode: Hi-Vis buttons, Amber signature, #9E4A00 links, Amber bolt on the left.

Area: suburb autocomplete + radius (10/25/50 km).

Next: Verify email → Setup checklist (D01).

pages.name: Verify email

Expired/invalid link state shown as a banner with a one-tap fix.
Both pages are simple centred cards on white with no app nav (the user isn’t fully in yet).

pages.name: Forgot / reset password

Expired/invalid link state shown as a banner with a one-tap fix.

pages.name: Session expired
pages.what: Dialog over the page: “You’ve been logged out” → log in again, keeps the page and any draft
notes: Decline price (C09): reasons optional, primary is the decline itself. “Saying no is free.”
Cancel job (C17): before payment = simple confirm, free. After payment = request with reason (Danger button), office reviews.
Session expired (B07): dialog over the page; logging in returns to the same page; drafts kept.
All dialogs: 16px radius, scrim 50%, M13 animation, focus trapped, Esc closes (except session expired), focus returns to the trigger. Max one dialog at a time.

pages.name: Two-step verification
pages.what: Code from SMS/app. Office accounts required, others optional

pages.name: Customer home
pages.what: Big “What needs doing?” box, jobs needing you (action cards), active jobs, categories, recent
notes: App nav (Forest, 68px): Home · My jobs · Messages, search (press / to focus), “Post a job” button, bell, avatar menu. Active tab has a Lime bar that slides (M16).
Greeting + one big “What needs doing?” box. Enter → Post a job with text.
Category tiles straddle the band edge (brand device). Hover lift (M03).
“Needs you” = only jobs waiting on the customer (price ready, please check, extra work). Card shown in hover state. Hidden when empty.
“In progress” = everything else active. New users see an empty state with the 3 steps instead.
Right column: popular job chips (pre-fill search) and a trust card.

pages.name: Post a job · describe
pages.what: Wizard: steps rail left, form centre, live summary card right. Description + type: main trades + Other (any labour: moving, cleaning, gardening, assembly…)
notes: Full-page wizard, focused: slim nav with “Draft saved” + Save & exit. No main nav while posting.
Steps rail: done = action tick, now = tint. Clicking a done step jumps back.
Type guessed from the words typed (simple keyword match), always editable. Main trades + Other: Other covers any labour, and “not sure” goes there too (the office re-types it if needed).
Live summary on the right fills in as they go. Free-to-post reassurance.
Draft autosaves (sessionStorage now, server draft when signed in).

pages.name: Post a job · photos
pages.what: Drag-and-drop zone + grid, 1–6 photos, safety tip
notes: Drop zone shown in its drag-over state (M26): solid action border + tint.
Each photo uploads straight away: progress ring (M18), × to remove (with Undo toast), failed = red outline + Retry.
Photos can be reordered by drag; the first is the cover.
Next waits for uploads to finish (button shows “Uploading 1…”).

pages.name: Post a job · where & when
pages.what: Address autocomplete (coverage area only) + time windows grid (next 7 days × morning/afternoon/evening), Any time, ASAP, access notes
pages.mockup: Post a job · where & when (time windows)
notes: Customers give time windows instead of messaging back and forth (decision: avoid direct messages where possible).
Grid of the next 7 days × morning / afternoon / evening. Tap to toggle; “Any time” fills all; “ASAP” flags urgency (raises the job in tradie pings).
Tradies then book one window (phone screen “Pick a time”). Customers can change windows from the job page until booked.
Address autocomplete is limited to the coverage area (Invercargill at launch); outside → waitlist page.

pages.name: Post a job · check & post
pages.what: Summary with edit links, hero “Post it”; signed-out → sign-up dialog
pages.mockup: Post a job · check & post (+ sign-up gate)
notes: Review: every section with Edit (jumps to that step, keeps everything).
“Post it” is the hero CTA (signature colour, Display type). Shown in hover state: lifts 1px + shadow (M04).
Signed out? “Post it” opens the sign-up dialog (same fields as B03, plus “Log in instead”). After sign-up + verify, the job posts automatically.
Posting: button spinner, page locked. Error: banner at top, nothing lost.

pages.name: Posted (success)
pages.what: Bolt-flash success, tracker, “we’ll let you know”, notification opt-in
notes: The bolt flash (M10): circle pops, tick draws, sparks burst, glow pulses. Once only.
“Posted.” in Display. Then the tracker (step 2 is “now”).
Ask for browser notification permission here, once, with our own card first (never the raw browser prompt on page load).
Also sends a confirmation email (G05).

pages.name: Job · getting your price
pages.what: Gallery + details left, sticky status card right (tracker, edit, cancel free)
notes: Desktop job page: left = gallery (click opens full-screen viewer, arrow keys), job details, info cards. Right = sticky status card (420px).
Status card: pill, one line of what’s happening, actions, tracker. Same card in every state; only its middle changes.
Editing is allowed until priced. Cancel is free here (simple confirm).
Gallery photo zooms slightly on hover (M03).

pages.name: Job · price ready
pages.what: Price reveal card: big price, inclusions, Accept & pay, No thanks
notes: The most important screen. Price reveal (M09): Forest block wipes in, $0 → $372.00 counts up, Lime underline draws, ticks appear one by one. Once per job.
Price is 52px Display, tabular numbers, “incl. GST” always.
3 reassurance ticks (wording per trade).
Hero “Accept & pay” → Checkout. “No thanks” → decline dialog (C09).
Also announced: email + push “Your price for Sub wiring is ready.”

pages.name: Checkout

notes: Focused checkout: slim nav, no distractions. TEST banner until real payments are switched on by both founders.
Card fields are the payment provider’s hosted fields (Stripe/Windcave), styled with our field tokens. Apple Pay / Google Pay buttons where supported.
Order summary sticky on the right. Pay button repeats the total.
States: processing (button spinner, page locked), 3-D Secure (provider dialog), declined (alert banner at top, keep method).

pages.name: Payment success
pages.what: Bolt flash, “Paid. You’re booked.”, receipt link, what happens next
notes: Bolt flash (M10) + plain message. Receipt also emailed (toast confirms, M14).
If payment fails we never show this page: back to checkout with the error.
Job page now shows “Booked · finding someone local”.

notes: Tradie card links to their public profile. “Licensed electrician” only when checked for that trade.
Messages preview inline on the job page (latest 3). Full thread in Messages.
Tracker collapses to 3 steps once paid. Status pill change animates (M25), tracker fills (M11).
⋯ menu (top of card, not shown): Request to cancel, Report a problem, Download receipt.

pages.name: Extra work approval
pages.what: Photos, description, extra cost, Approve & pay / Decline
notes: Opens automatically when they land on the job (from email/push) and from the “Needs your OK” card.
Photos are required from the tradie; click to enlarge.
Approve → same checkout for the extra amount. Decline → small confirm, tradie notified.
Dialog M13. Focus starts on the heading, not the Approve button (no accidental Enter).

Rating inline: stars (signature colour) + quick tags; a comment box appears after choosing stars.
“Yes, all sorted” → bolt flash “Sorted.” + review saved. “Something’s not right” → report form (C16), pauses auto-release.
Countdown is real: show “46h left” when under 48h.

Empty states per tab (e.g. Done: “Nothing finished yet.”).

Refunds: negative amount + Refunded pill.

pages.name: Job · needs a $30 quick look
pages.what: AI can’t price from photos/estimates: book a $30 quick look (comes off the price if they go ahead), pick windows, then normal price flow. New status QUOTE_BOUNTY
notes: Shown when the Trade Marketplace AI can’t settle a price from the photos and estimates. New status needed in the code (QUOTE_BOUNTY).
Plain words, no machinery: “hard to price from photos… pop round… one fixed price”.
Customer picks times that suit; the tradie books one of them (tradie map, site visit job).
Decided: $30, paid by the customer, comes off the final price if they go ahead. On the tradie side it appears as a gold quote bounty for 24h.
After the visit the flow carries on as normal: price ready → accept & pay → sorted.

pages.name: Saved addresses
pages.what: List, add/edit dialog, default

pages.name: Tradie home · setup checklist
pages.what: New tradies: checklist (verify email, licence, photo, bank & IRD, work area, alerts) + progress; then becomes the job board
notes: First visits land here until setup is complete; then /jobs becomes the job board. A slim “Finish setup (4/6)” banner stays on the board until done.
Progress bar + checklist. Done items struck through; “Checking” pill while the office verifies.
Each “Add” opens the relevant settings page and returns here.
Right: honest “while you wait” (estimates allowed before verification) + 4-step explainer.

pages.name: Job board · list
pages.what: Filters sidebar, tabs Ready to claim / Needs estimate, photo grid, sort
notes: App nav in trade mode: “Tradie” flag, Find work · My work · Earnings · Messages. Amber active bar.
Filters sidebar (240px). Trades not verified are shown but disabled with the reason. Filters live in the URL.
Grid/Map toggle (segmented, M16). Sort: Nearest, Newest, Highest pay.
Photo tiles keep the source look; Amber tag shows what they earn; white “Needs estimate” tag otherwise. Hover lift + photo zoom (M03), saved = filled bookmark (M23).
Pagination: infinite scroll with skeleton tiles (M15). New jobs while browsing: “3 new jobs” pill at the top, click to load.

pages.name: Job board · map (desktop)
pages.what: Uber-style: list left, map right. 3 pin kinds: ready to claim (what you earn), needs an estimate (photos), needs a site visit (in person). Filter chips with counts, legend, hover row↔pin
pages.states: No location permission · nothing in view
notes: Uber-style map of every job near you, three kinds: Forest “$259” = ready to claim (what you earn); white “Estimate” + camera = quote from photos; GOLD “$30 · 17h” = quote bounty (go and quote in person).
Quick filter chips with live counts. The Bounty chip is gold too. Same filters as the grid; state in the URL.
Hover a row → its pin grows with a signature ring (and the reverse). Click a pin → preview card; click card → job page (M21).
Legend card bottom-left so the pin types are obvious on first use. Dismissible; remembered per user.

Bounty card: gold outline, countdown ring (bounties expire 24h after they’re created), $30 for an in-person quote, “Claim bounty”. Gold pins shimmer every few seconds (M27): it should feel like a game.
“Other” jobs (any labour) appear like any other trade, labelled Other. Anyone can take Other jobs.

pages.name: Job map (phone)
pages.what: Full-screen map, “You’re available” switch, floating chips (All · Claim · Bounty · Estimate), gold bounty pins, bottom sheet with swipeable job cards
pages.states: Available on/off · no jobs in view
notes: Full-screen map, like Uber. Blue dot = you. Pins: Forest “$259” = ready to claim (what you earn); white + camera = quote from photos; GOLD “$30 · 17h” = quote bounty.
Gold = easy money. Bounties shimmer (M27), sort first in the sheet, and have their own chip. It should feel like a game.
“You’re available” switch: on = pinged about new jobs and bounties nearby. Off = browse quietly.
Bottom sheet peeks with swipeable job cards. Swiping centres the pin; tapping a pin scrolls to its card (M21). Drag up for the full list.

pages.name: Quote bounty (quote in person)
pages.what: Gold $30 bounty, 24h countdown, Claim bounty → pick a customer window → visit → send fixed price; AI checks it; first dibs if accepted + fair, ignored if way off
notes: Triggered when the Trade Marketplace AI can’t settle a price from the photos and estimates: a $30 bounty appears on the map for 24h.
Anyone good can claim it; one person at a time. After claiming, pick one of the customer’s windows to visit (no messaging needed).
After the visit, send a fixed price. The AI checks it against the other estimates and its own prediction.
If the price is accepted and fair, the quoter gets first dibs on the job. Way off (e.g. $1,200 on a $300 job): it’s ignored and the job opens to everyone.
Countdown ring shrinks to 0 (M27). Expired → the office decides.

pages.name: New job & bounty ping (when available)
pages.what: Card over the map: distance, what you earn, time left (bounties gold), See / Skip. Quiet hours
notes: When “available” is on, new jobs and bounties near you pop in as a card (M14/M20) and as a push when the app is closed.
Shows what you earn, how far and the time left. Bounty pings are gold.
Skip hides it from your pings (not from the map). One ping at a time; quiet hours default 9pm–7am.

pages.name: Lead adds a crew
pages.what: Crew panel on the workspace + drawer: pick from your crew or any worker, their part, share % / $ (adds to 100%), send invite
notes: Team jobs (decision 6a): the lead claims the job and adds crew with a split they set. Shares must add to 100%; the lead’s share updates live.
“Your crew” = people you’ve worked with or added (like friends). You can also search any worker.

web: Same components, wider layouts: Desktop rearranges the mobile components. It doesn’t invent new styles. Anything new goes into web.css with a name.
Content max 1200px, centred: 12 columns, 24px gutters. Reading text max 680px. Forms max 560–760px, one column.
One main action per view: One primary or hero button per screen or card. Everything else is secondary, ghost or a link.
Sticky where it helps: App nav sticky. On job pages the status card sticks to the right as you scroll. Wizard summary sticks.
Everything clickable shows it: Pointer cursor, a hover state and a focus ring. Cards lift (M03), rows tint, links underline.
Hover never hides information: Nothing important only appears on hover (touch screens and keyboards can’t hover). Hover only adds polish.
Keyboard first-class: / focuses search, Esc closes overlays, Enter submits, arrows move in galleries and steppers. Tab order follows reading order.
Drawers for side tasks, dialogs for decisions: Estimate and extra work open in a right drawer (keep context). Confirms and money decisions use a dialog.
Brand device on every big moment: Forest band + bolt at 20% on heroes, headers and success screens. Bolt flash (M10) only for real wins.
Same URL, every device: Every page works from 320px to 2560px. Same routes; layout adapts.
motion: Motion confirms something happened. It never makes people wait: nothing over 400ms blocks input.
Only animate transform and opacity (plus clip-path for M09). Never width, height, top or left (except M24).
Big celebrations (M09 price reveal, M10 bolt flash) run once per event, never on revisits or refreshes.
prefers-reduced-motion: everything becomes an instant change, except the skeleton (static grey, no shimmer).
No bouncing logos, spinning loaders on full pages, auto-playing carousels or confetti. The bolt flash is our one flourish.

decided_2026_10_23.decision: Anyone can take Other jobs and unrestricted work. Checks are loose at the start; checked workers get a verified badge. Restricted work (electrical, plumbing, gasfitting, drainlaying, restricted building work) still needs a licence on file before claiming.

When the Trade Marketplace AI can’t settle a price from photos + estimates, a $30 quote bounty appears (gold on the map, 24h). Anyone good can claim it, visit in a customer window, and send a fixed price. The AI checks it against the estimates and its own prediction.
The customer books a $30 quick look; it comes off the final price if they go ahead.
The quoter gets first dibs only if their price is accepted and the AI deems it fair. Way-off quotes are ignored and the job opens to everyone.

One lead per job. The lead sets each person’s split and invites crew (accept/decline). Everyone is paid their share through payroll. The customer only sees the lead. Later: request a specialist inside a job.
Invite only, tougher screening. Earn $30 per quote + 2% of jobs where their price is accepted, fair and the job finishes without a dispute + a weekly bonus for accurate quotes.
Stripe, with Apple Pay. Real payments switch on last, after lots of testing.
One shared rate + an Other rate at launch; per-trade rates possible later (configurable in Settings).
Customers give time windows; workers book one. Preset updates (on my way, running late, reschedule) instead of chat where possible.
Hidden until a job is claimed, then both sides can see them.
